title: Corrupt-line policy
prompt: Implement `static (int Loaded, int Skipped) LoadScoresLenient(string path, List<(int Id, string Name, int Score)> into)`: parses each `id|name|score` line; well-formed lines load, malformed lines (wrong field count, non-numeric id/score) are skipped and counted. Returns both counts.

tests.name: mixed
tests.hint: Good rows survive bad neighbors — skip, don't crash, don't lose data.

tests.name: edge
tests.hint: An empty file is not corruption; the counts must say exactly that.
